description: Test suite for FastAPI application endpoints, utilizing pytest and TestClient to verify API responses, including successful retrievals and error handling.

classes.name: ModuleType
classes.description: Type imported from types module, used for type hinting the imported modules.

methods.name: get_mod(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on test parameters for dependency injection in tests.

methods.name: test_get_no_item(mod: ModuleType)
methods.description: Tests API response when requesting a non-existent item, expects 404 with specific detail message.

methods.name: test_get(mod: ModuleType)
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of an existing item, expecting status 200 and correct JSON response.

methods.name: test_internal_error(mod: ModuleType)
methods.description: Tests API behavior when an internal error is raised, expecting the specific exception and message.

methods.name: test_internal_server_error(mod: ModuleType)
methods.description: Tests server error response, expecting status 500 and specific error text.
